name: Dialog
summary: Modal surface that interrupts for a focused task.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled, always. The dialog never closes itself; it asks, through onClose, and you decide. Two sources for one piece of state is how a dialog gets stuck open.

props.name: title
props.description: Rendered as the <h2> in the header and used as the accessible name. Required: a modal with no name announces only "dialog".

props.name: children
props.description: The body. It is the part that scrolls; the header and footer stay put.

props.name: footer
props.description: The actions row. Leave it out and the footer is not rendered at all, rather than rendered empty.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called by Escape, by the backdrop, and by the close button — one exit for the three, so a dialog cannot be dismissable one way and not another.

props.name: size
props.description: The width (B-03), chosen by Victor: HeroUI's four (xs 320, sm 384, md 448, lg 512), then xl (1024, the --breakpoint-lg token) for a wide detail view, and full — the screen minus the usual margin, keeping the 22 radius. The default became HeroUI's md, 448; up to 0.8.14 every dialog was 560.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: false keeps the dialog open during an operation (C-07): no Escape, no click outside, and the close button is DISABLED rather than hidden, so the header does not move mid-operation.
